claim: Actual native mvcc-core scalar transactions with reader-owned scoped handles and separately charged precommit exports. No generic-payload, transferable-native-session, live-socket, native concurrent-writer, heap-bound or final performance admission.
selection_basis: Eight fixed native/scoped/export/batch configurations of one published crate, plus fourteen fixed controls. Native sessions use Rc/RefCell handles on the owning thread; four-reader probes begin native transactions on each reader before writing. Exported views are transferable and materialize native own-writes before commit, charging scan/map construction. Both use the exact original scalar trace, warmup, full-value model, ordered journal and timing loop. No extra payload padding or shadow authoritative map.

build.command: python3 tools/freeze_benchmarks.py v34m2 --features native-mvcc-comparisons --bench-prefix native_mvcc_ --layers state
build.reason: Native scalar and exported-reader paths share the original harness with an untimed thread-probe hook. Original transferable probes retain explicit Send/Sync bounds. All controls run in the same frozen binary.

claims: native staged capture failure rolls back without metadata publication
empty revision advances with empty journal batch
native active transactions return to zero

native_scope_limit: Native Rc/RefCell session-handle acquisition is owner-thread only and is not a transferable snapshot-acquisition score. Full threaded rows for native sessions use transactions created on reader threads. Do not count local handle acquisition as beating a Send/Sync publisher.
unmeasured_revision_reason: Do not charge an avoidable native transaction for metadata-only empty logical revisions. Both native/exported modes preserve state, exact empty journal batch and revision without opening or committing a native transaction. Prior source remains in Git; unselected generated v34mvcc build has no timing or proof result.
